item.title: A24 Is Going For Best Picture History As 'Cliff Booth' Unfurls [Contender Countdown]
item.description: Historical trends for the Academy Awards are meant to be broken. From embarrassingly long waits for major wins for women, African Americans, Asian, Latino, and openly LGBTQ+ nominees to international films taking Best Picture, change does happen. But, as in life, and for better or worse, it's often incremental. "Parasite" was the first non-English language film to win Best Picture, but many incredible nominees came before it. Now, A24 is attempting to make history by not only shepherding "You Can See Everything" as the first documentary to earn a Best Picture nomination, but also the first documentary to win.
